name: That's Asking A Lot
objectiveText: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars , 1 Golden Rod , 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs , and 8 Unstable Triggers . You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items. Thorium Bar  ( 2 ) Golden Rod  ( 1 ) Hi-Explosive Bomb  ( 8 ) Unstable Trigger  ( 8 )

comments.body:
Before you correct someone's math make sure you know all the facts first.

3 Mithril = Mithril Casing
2 Solid Stone = Solid Blasting Powder

1 Mageweave, 1 Solid Blasting Powder, 1 Mithril = Unstable Trigger

2 Mithril Casing, 1 Unstable Trigger, 2 Solid Blasting Powder = 4x HI-Explosive Bombs.

So in total we need
2 HI-Explosive Bomb Combines = 
 4 Mithril casings(12 Mithril)
 2 Unstable Triggers(2 Mithril, 2 Mageweave, 2  Solid Blasting Powder(4 Solid Stone))
 4 Solid Blasting Powder(8 Solid Stone)

8 Unstable triggers(8 Mithril, 8 Mageweave 8 Solid Blasting Powder(16 Solid Stone)

1 Gold Bar
2 Coarse Grinding Stone = 4 Coarse Stones
2 Thorium Bars

When we add of of them up we have
22 Mithril
10 Mageweave
28 Solid Stone
1 Gold Bar
2 Thorium Bar
4 Coarse Grinding Stone
replies: Thanks for the list but the sum at the end is wrong, you only need 4 Coarse Stones = 2 Coarse Grinding Stones, not 4 Coarse Grindings Stones which would be 8 Coarse Stones ;)

comments.body:
Just as a further note to anyone asking if doing this quest is worth it. Spoiler alert: it’s not and I will tell you why.

The follow-up gives a few rewards including a FR cloak - at max lvl you can net around 8g from completing the quest if you vendor the rewards. However, like most people have already pointed out, all [i]the materials needed in this step can be time consuming to make or expensive to buy depending on your server’s economy[/i]. 

People have said that the [b]cloak is great for MC - however this would only be the case on a new server that doesn’t have Onyxia on farm[/b]. Onyxia Scale Cloak prices to begin with were around 80-120g, but in Phase 5, prices will plummet dramatically - I have picked up the Onyxia cloak for about 23g for my alts. Putting the FR enchant in the cloak from this reward would be a waste of materials (mostly Elemental Fire.)

The gear rewards are so-so, but I would say you can [b] invest your time better by farming pre-raid BiS[/b] gear from dungeons instead. 

People say that the [i]Moist Towlette[/i] reward more than makes up for it, but to be quite honest...it’s the kind of [b]limited-use item that you will carry in your bags for months on end forgetting you even have it[/b]. It just takes up an extra bag space. Unnecessarily I might add. 

[i]The only scenario that I can see where this quest is worth doing is if you are stacked on alts with the right professions and have a surplus of materials so you can craft all the required items yourself with stock that you already have.[/i] And no, whilst you’re are levelling it is not worth doing for the XP as you will spend more time buying materials and finding crafters for the items which is a lot of down-time. The only time you should be in any AH city is if you’re having down time, a quest instructs you to visit them, if you’re buying gear or training your abilities. Otherwise continuing your world quests is most efficient.

Anything else is just a waste of gold and time to be honest. Hope this helps some of you decide wether you will actually do this quest.
Buying all this stuff at the AH is about 16G cost on my server... A bit too much I feel ^^

First I'm an engineer with the quest open and my engineering craft window open. 
Second I will try to not make a mistake and be complete in my information. 
Thrid I will start with the final desired product and break it down into the componets it takes to make, then break those down. Often a piece (mithril casing) can be bought for less on AH then the raw materials to make it.

Smokey LaRue wants;
2 thorium bars,
1 golden rod,
8 Hi-Explosive bombs,
8 Unstable triggers.

8 Hi-Explosive bombs takes 2 makes of,
4 Hi-Explosive bombs per make takes 
2 Mithril Casing,
1 Unstable trigger
2 Solid blasting powder.

4 Mithril Casing @ 3 Mithril bar per = 12 Mithril bars (for the casings)

10 Unstable triggers (yes ten) @ 1 mithril bar, 1 mageweave cloth, 1 solid blasting powder per = 10 Mitril bar, 10 mageweave cloth, 10 solid blasting powder.

14 Solid blasting powder @ 2 solid stone per = 28 solid stone.
(edit) yes 14, 10 for the 10 unstable triggers and 4 for the 2 makes of 4 Hi-Explosive bombs. 

So if walk up to an Engineer and hand him,
28 solid stone,
22 Mithril bars,
10 Mageweave Cloth,
and ask politly and possibly include some coin he can hand you back
8 Hi-Explosive bombs and 
8 Unstable triggers.

You can also hand him,
14 solid blasting powder
2  Mithril casings
10 mithril bars
10 mageweave cloth
and he can hand you back the same 
8 Hi-Explosive bombs
8 Unstable triggers.

The reason I break it down like this is often Mithril casings or solid blasting powder will sell for less then the ingrediants to make them. This is do to people skilling up on these items then dumping them on AH.
